name: Cecily Stormhold

goals.text: wed my heir into a great house

memories: Maud Strand betrayed me and gave Windcross to House Thornvale.
voice: patient, wrathful lord of House Stormhold; speaks like a proud noble
backstory: Lost Windcross when Maud Strand opened its gates to Thornvale, and has waited three summers to take it back. Offered her daughter Genevieve to Jory Ironreach and was refused. Turned away Sunspire's daughter in her turn, and the Greyfords' after.
